text: 1. Scanned copy of a valid foreign ordinary passport;2. Notarized high school diploma or equivalent certificate (fresh graduates can use pre-graduation certificate or high school grades to apply);3. Academic transcripts. Transcripts of all senior high school courses (original and notarized);4. Proof of Chinese proficiency (those whose native language is Chinese are not required by our school);5. Study plan. In Chinese or English, no less than 600 words;6. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners (this form is printed by the health and quarantine Department of China and must be filled out in English or Chinese);7. Students who have studied in China need to provide proof of no criminal record (within 6 months);8. Other supporting materials (if available).
